question: Can a frozen, mechanically selected source catalogue be replayed reproducibly with every execution, abstention, and error retained?
claim_boundary: This protocol may strengthen artifact-reliability and anti-cherry-picking evidence only. It does not establish project accuracy, WER, speaker/session transfer, hardware, user, or product performance.

source_scope.training_overlap: unknown; no cohort may be called held out until checkpoint training membership is proved

development.purpose: future decoder or threshold development only

denominator_policy: Every frozen selection remains in the denominator, including abstentions, errors, and failed executions.
allowed_reporting: asset verification and strict-load pass/fail counts
descriptive candidate-held, mismatch, abstention, error, and asset-failure counts
prohibited_reporting_without_new_approva: project accuracy, WER, CER, command accuracy, or confidence
held-out performance while training overlap is unknown
comparative ranking across incompatible modalities, tasks, decoders, or metrics
cross-speaker, cross-session, wearable, hardware, user, or product claims
